question: What is India’s rank in the 2025 SDG Index?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**99**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India enters top 100 in UN's global Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) rankings for first time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India ranks 99th** out of **167 countries** in the **2025 SDG Index**, with a **score of 67**.

 
 
• 
 
This is the **first time** India entered the **top 100** in the **Sustainable Development Report (SDR)** by the **UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network**.

 
 
• 
 
**China** ranks **49th** with a score of **74.4**.

 
 
• 
 
**India’s neighbours:**

 
 
• 
 
**Bhutan:** 74th (70.5)

 
 
• 
 
**Nepal:** 85th (68.6)

 
 
• 
 
**Bangladesh:** 114th (63.9)

 
 
• 
 
**Pakistan:** 140th (57)

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Maritime neighbours:**

 
 
• 
 
**Maldives:** 53rd

 
 
• 
 
**Sri Lanka:** 93rd

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**US ranks 44th** with a score of **75.2**.

 
 
• 
 
**Top global performers:**

 
 
• 
 
**1st:** Finland

 
 
• 
 
**2nd:** Sweden

 
 
• 
 
**3rd:** Denmark

 
 
• 
 
19 of the **top 20** are **European countries**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**SDG Index score range:**

 
 
• 
 
**0 = no progress**, **100 = all 17 SDGs achieved**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Global progress stalled:** Only **17% of SDG targets** projected to be achieved by **2030**.

 
 
• 
 
SDGs adopted in **2015** to ensure **no one is left behind** by **2030**.
